text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki has managed to leave quite a mark on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together, we've successfully navigated the crucial first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I mull over my complicated feelings as I walk to my office one rest day.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm surprised to see Fuji Kiseki since we don't have a meeting scheduled for today. I wonder if she needs something.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I was just practicing some magic tricks!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I like practicing here because it calms me, and I feel like I won't mess up.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure why, but maybe it's because my body remembers what it feels like to train in here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I think about how Fuji Kiseki has found a safe space in this room, a faint sense of happiness bubbles up in me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Anyway, since you're back, I should wrap up my practice session!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now that you're here, it's show time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She bows her head formally.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Welcome to Fuji Kiseki's magic show! Let yourself be guided to a world of magic and wonder!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: As you see, there are no tricks up my sleeve, and this is no more than a simple coin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She shows me the coin and passes it expertly between her hands.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now, I'll make it disappear into thin air! Don't blink or you'll miss it! Three, two, one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ping!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She flicks the coin in the air, and I watch it whirl with intense force until, suddenly, it disappears!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …Yesss!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much! I hope you enjoyed that!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now, for my next trick…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She takes out a deck of cards for her next act, but I'm still caught up on her little exclamation of triumph.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For the three years I've known her, Fuji Kiseki has always played the role of "Fuji Kiseki."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's extremely rare for her mask to slip and her true feelings to peek out.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now, please select one card from… Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, dear… Did you hear that earlier?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That trick is really difficult. I don't often pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I thought that if I practiced as if I was in front of a real audience, I might get the hang of it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And just as I thought, it worked just the way it's supposed to. But I got a little too excited.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She watches me with furrowed brows and mixed feelings plain on her face.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Do you think you could keep that a secret?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It appears she really didn't mean to let out that triumphant whisper, and the little mistake has her flustered.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If I wasn't her trainer, I doubt she would've come to my office to practice her tricks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not once did I ever doubt Fuji Kiseki was anything less than a perfect entertainer. And when I think of that…
choice_data_list: I'm so glad I'm your trainer.
I'm so glad I'm your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Um… I'm honored to hear that, but talk about sudden…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems embarrassed. She shifts, and a single coin slips from her sleeve.
